Less Distributions: From net investment income (0.41 )'. 1.87 - 0.41 = 1.46. In dollars: year 13,783 less nine months 2,778 = 11,005 thousand distributed in the quarter. The year's per-unit figure is tagged only on the filer's own concept (ck0001825265:InvestmentCompanyDistributionsPerShareFromNetInvestmentIncomeLoss) and the 2023 10-K prints '-' in the 2022 'Total distributions' cell, so the quarter was published as -0.45 with a rate of 0.

notes: TCW Direct Lending VIII tags its paid-in line 'Common Unitholders capital' as us-gaap:MembersCapital and its total capital as us-gaap:MembersEquity; the shared concept order reads MembersCapital as net assets, so every quarter is set from the printed 'Total Members Capital'. The investments totals excluding cash (printed 'Total Debt Investments' / 'Total Debt & Equity Investments') are set where no undimensioned fact is filed: fair value for the first three quarters of 2023, cost for nine quarters. Interest expense (2026-10-18, round two): the filer tags its printed 'Interest and credit facility expenses' as us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense, which the income concept map does not read, so the map's 'interestexpense' substring published the directors' fee (NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFees) or the repurchase-transaction interest (RepurchaseAgreementsInterestExpenseAmount, a separate printed line). Both are suppressed and InterestAndDebtExpense is the interest_expense fallback.
